requirements: R1: The machine starts in the Idle state with no stored credit and no drink being dispensed.
R2: When the user inserts a valid coin while in Idle, the machine stores exactly one credit and moves to the CreditAvailable state.
R3: When the user presses the coffee button while in CreditAvailable, the machine dispenses coffee and moves to the Dispensing state.
R4: When the user presses the tea button while in CreditAvailable, the machine dispenses tea and moves to the Dispensing state.
R5: When the user presses any drink button while in Idle, the machine must not dispense any drink and must remain in Idle.
R6: When drink dispensing completes while in Dispensing, the machine clears the transaction credit and returns to Idle.
R7: When the user presses cancel while in CreditAvailable, the machine returns the stored coin and returns to Idle.
R8: When the user presses cancel while in Idle, the machine must not return any coin and must remain in Idle.
R9: While in Dispensing, pressing any drink button must not start a second dispense and the machine must remain in Dispensing.
R10: The machine must never dispense coffee and tea within the same transaction.
R11: The machine must never dispense any drink unless a credit was stored after the most recent return to Idle.
R12: When the user inserts a coin while in CreditAvailable, the machine must reject the additional coin and remain in CreditAvailable with exactly one credit.
R13: While in Dispensing, the machine must ignore cancel requests and remain in Dispensing until dispensing completes.
